name: Tignes
description: Tignes sits at 2,100m in the Tarentaise valley, linked with Val d'Isere via the Espace Killy (300km). It has the largest glacier ski area in Europe (Grande Motte, 3,456m) for 11 months of summer skiing. Tignes is more purpose-built and less polished than Val d'Isere — less expensive, more functional, and with a passionate freeride and snowboarding culture. Hosted the 1992 Albertville speed-skiing events. Lively and young at heart.

overview.atmosphere: High-altitude, snow-sure, purpose-built. Europe's largest glacier for summer skiing. The no-nonsense freeride partner to Val d'Isere's polish.

when_to_go.season_open: Oct to early May, plus summer skiing
when_to_go.snow_reliability_detail: 10/10 -- highest in the Alps with glacier

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Paragliding from Grande Motte, snowpark, speed-skiing heritage, X Games qualifiers

villages.name: Tignes-le-Lac
villages.character: Main village, car-free centre, lake (frozen in winter), shops, restaurants, apres

villages.name: Tignes-Val Claret
villages.character: Higher satellite, quieter, closer to Grande Motte glacier lift

villages.name: Les Brevieres
villages.character: Valley floor, traditional hamlet, quiet, lower altitude

honest_drawbacks: Winter conditions can be harsh (cold, windy)
Limited luxury compared to Courchevel/Val d'Isere
